name: firmware_status
description: Show the camera's firmware status: active and inactive versions, build date and whether the firmware is committed.

name: firmware_check
description: Check the camera's firmware version against an expected version, or against another camera. Give expected_version or compare_to.

expected_version.description: Version the camera should be running, e.g. "12.1.0"

compare_to.description: Another camera's identifier to compare with

name: firmware_upgrade
description: Upload a firmware .bin file from the server's disk and install it. The camera reboots. Only runs with confirm set to true. The file is not committed unless auto_commit is set, so the camera can roll back by itself.

file_path.description: Path of the firmware .bin file on the machine running this server

confirm.description: Must be true: the upgrade reboots the camera

wait.description: Wait for the camera to come back online

wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the reboot

auto_commit.description: Commit the firmware once the camera is back (needs wait)

name: param_get
description: Read camera parameters by key or group, e.g. "root.Brand" or "root.Brand.ProdNbr". Values of secrets (passwords, tokens, community strings) are shown as [redacted].

param.description: Parameter key or group name starting with root.

name: param_set
description: Set camera parameters by explicit key. No wildcards or groups; keys under root.Network, root.Users and root.Properties are refused because they can lock you out of the camera.

assignments.description: Parameter keys and their new values, e.g. {"root.Image.I0.Appearance.Rotation": "180"}

name: imaging_get
description: Read the image sensor settings (brightness, contrast, exposure, WDR and others) as parameters.

name: imaging_set
description: Change image sensor settings. Only parameters that exist under root.ImageSource.I0.Sensor on this camera can be set; use imaging_get to see them.

settings.description: Setting names and values, e.g. {"WDR": "on"}; names may be given with or without the root.ImageSource.I0.Sensor. prefix

name: fleet_health
description: Check the health of several cameras in parallel: reachability, model, firmware, latency and issues. Defaults to every configured camera.

targets.description: A group name from cameras.yaml, or camera identifiers separated by commas

name: security_audit
description: Audit the security posture of one camera, or of every configured camera when camera_id is left out: unencrypted HTTP, old firmware, default user, SSH, UPnP, anonymous viewing and more.

name: backup_params
description: Save a camera's parameters as a JSON file on the machine running this server (they can contain secrets, so the file is readable by its owner only). Returns the path and the number of parameters, not the parameters.

name: diff_params
description: Compare the parameters of two cameras and list what differs. Values of secrets are shown as [redacted]. At most 500 differences are returned.

name: cert_list
description: List the certificates installed on a camera.

name: stream_urls
description: Build RTSP, MJPEG and snapshot URLs for a camera. The URLs carry no credentials; use the camera's user and password to authenticate.

codec.description: Video codec for the RTSP URL

stream_profile.description: Stream profile number for the RTSP URL

name: selftest
description: Run the camera's built-in self test and return its result. Some cameras only allow it in preview mode.

name: zipstream_status
description: Show the camera's ZipStream compression profiles and maximum level.

name: disk_status
description: Show the disks of a camera: file system, whether the disk is encrypted, status and health, used and free space, and how many recordings it holds (with the oldest and newest start time). Look at this before formatting or switching encryption.

name: disk_format
description: Format a disk of the camera and mount it again. Erases every recording on it. Only runs with confirm set to true. The call waits for the format job to finish.

confirm.description: Must be true: formatting erases every recording on the disk

wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the format job

name: disk_encrypt
description: Turn encryption of a camera's disk on or off. Erases every recording on it (the camera formats the card), and a lost passphrase makes an encrypted card unreadable. Only runs with confirm set to true. The passphrase is not a parameter: the server reads it from the environment variable VAPX_DISK_PASSPHRASE or the file named by VAPX_DISK_PASSPHRASE_FILE. Changing the passphrase is CLI-only.

enable.description: true turns encryption on, false turns it off

confirm.description: Must be true: the switch erases every recording on the disk

wait_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the job
